projects.title: Cost-Aware Inference
projects.problem: Hardware speed alone cannot answer what an accepted completed business task costs.
projects.implemented: An interactive presentation and Python proof service compare healthcare or financial-services workloads across CPU, accelerator and heterogeneous paths.

projects.consumption: A seven-minute decision story, a guided engineering view and alternative creative treatments share the same proof contract. Costs remain an execution proxy; case scores are not general model-quality claims.
projects.reusable_capability: One typed proof API supports an engineering story, The Great CPU Bake Off and The Ministry of Sensible Compute; workload, presentation and placement policy are separable.

maturity.label: Implemented demo

claim_boundaries: Execution-cost proxy excludes utilization, queueing, power, cooling, acquisition, depreciation and operations.
A comparison changes selected model plus policy, not hardware in isolation.
